newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market up $1-$2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market up $1-$2 - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to last test on Thursday - Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said.
Trade moderate. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest moderate to good. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 69.00-70.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 68.50-70.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to last test on Thursday - Slaughter steers and heifers 1.00-2.00 higher.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 111.00-112.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 106.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 101.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 111.00-112.00.
